purpose: Teach: 割高/協業/行程/必勝/品切れ/伝言/月給/当座

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、防犯機材が割高で困っております
lines.en: We're having trouble with the cost of crime prevention equipment.
lines.style: Professional, measured. Slight pause before speaking—careful word choice. Calm exhale. Speaking as an institution, not personally, but with quiet weight beneath.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、民間との協業強化、ありがたいです
lines.en: Yes. We're grateful for the strengthened collaboration between police and private sectors.
lines.style: Warm, responsive. Gentle agreement that lands solidly. Respectful but not stiff—the tone of someone who means what he says. Steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、捜査の行程をご家族にもご説明します
lines.en: We'll make sure to explain the investigation process clearly to your family.
lines.style: Reassuring but official. Firm on the promise. Slightly slower pace—each word deliberate. The kindness underneath the procedure.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、年末防犯キャンペーンの必勝態勢ですね
lines.en: Yes—so this year-end crime prevention campaign is in full gear, then.
lines.style: Engaged, conversational. Light nod in the voice. Not performing agreement, but genuinely following along. Slightly brighter energy.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、防犯グッズの品切れに、警察、お困りなんですね
lines.en: So the crime prevention supplies are running out—that's adding to the strain, isn't it.
lines.style: Reflective, gently testing what he's hearing. Thoughtful pause. Soft concern showing through. Checking in—not asking for confirmation, but offering understanding.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、市民への伝言は、確実にお伝えします
lines.en: We'll make sure any messages for the public get delivered clearly and directly.
lines.style: Steady, reassuring. Quiet conviction. Professional but human—not robotic. A promise wrapped in procedure.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、若手警察官の月給改善が課題ですね
lines.en: The salary situation for younger officers is something that needs attention, isn't it.
lines.style: Thoughtful observation. Gentle but pointed—he's not asking, he's acknowledging. Slight concern underneath. Collaborative tone, not accusatory.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、当座の捜査費用を確保しております
lines.en: We've secured the funds we need for the immediate investigation.
lines.style: Quiet confidence. Not triumphant—factual and grounded. The relief of having logistics handled. Warm closure to the conversation.
